# descope_emailverification_settings (Resource)

Manages the project-level email verification authentication settings (beta). This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether flows can sign users in with an email verification token, a proof from the user's email provider that the browser hands the flow instead of a code. Email verification is in beta and can only be enabled for projects it is available to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
